output.claims_about_business_cost: No business-cost claim is needed to justify the policy reading. The admissible evidence shows no approved mitigation. The policy text also states that aggregate passing results do not erase subgroup weakness and that small-sample uncertainty does not convert an unresolved materiality question into a clean certification. The proper policy treatment is therefore caveated compliance conditioned on explicit disclosure, not minor-caveat wording and not a clean-compliance finding.
